payload.title: Routing and NAT
payload.summary: Apply deterministic longest-prefix routing and model bounded, caller-owned NAT mappings in portable C17.

prerequisites: IPv4 addresses and CIDR prefix lengths
Fixed-width integers, arrays, size_t, and decoded network-order bytes
outcomes: Select routes by longest prefix, metric, and stable table order
Model endpoint-dependent outbound and reverse-only inbound NAT
Keep checked outputs and caller-owned mappings transactional

payload.exercise: Implement canonical route selection, caller-owned NAT initialization, outbound reuse/allocation, reverse-only inbound translation, and expiry in exercise.c.
payload.reference: Compare against solution.c only after implementing the lesson.h status and transactional-output contract.
checks: Longest-prefix selection with metric and stable-order tie breakers
First-port allocation, mapping reuse, and public-port uniqueness
Remote-endpoint matching and inbound reverse-only behavior
Exhaustion, expiry, reuse after expiry, alias support, and rollback

allowed: Pure in-memory route tables, tuples, and caller-owned mappings
Local arrays and direct function calls
excluded: System networking, DNS, file access, allocation, or mutable globals
External access, raw capture, privilege, or interface configuration
A production router, firewall, carrier-grade NAT, or packet-rewrite path
